ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The problem gives textual conditions: In triangle ABC, a=1, ∠A=π/6, ∠B=π/4. According to the specified method, understand the C in the blank according to the standard answer as asking for the side length c, namely side AB, rather than asking for angle C. First use the sum of the interior angles of a triangle to find the third angle: ∠C=π-∠A-∠B=π-π/6-π/4=π-2π/12-3π/12=7π/12. By the sine rule, a/sin A=c/sin C, so c=a·sin C/sin A. Substituting a=1, ∠A=π/6, ∠C=7π/12, gives c=sin(7π/12)/sin(π/6). Calculate sin(7π/12). Because 7π/12=π-5π/12, sin(7π/12)=sin(5π/12)=sin(π/4+π/6). Expanding gives sin(π/4+π/6)=sinπ/4 cosπ/6+cosπ/4 sinπ/6=(√2/2)(√3/2)+(√2/2)(1/2)=(√6+√2)/4. Also sin(π/6)=1/2, therefore c=((√6+√2)/4)/(1/2)=(√6+√2)/2.

method.method_draft: 将题目中的目标按标准答案理解为求边长 c（即 AB），而不是角 C。先从题干读出 a=BC=1，∠A=π/6，∠B=π/4。由三角形内角和求 ∠C=π-π/6-π/4=7π/12。再用正弦定理 a/sin A=c/sin C，所以 c=a·sin C/sin A=1·sin(7π/12)/sin(π/6)。计算 sin(7π/12)=sin(5π/12)=sin(π/4+π/6)=(√6+√2)/4，sin(π/6)=1/2，得到 c=(√6+√2)/2。
method.CoT_raw:

先由三角形内角和求第三个角：∠C=π-∠A-∠B=π-π/6-π/4=π-2π/12-3π/12=7π/12。

由正弦定理，a/sin A=c/sin C，所以 c=a·sin C/sin A。代入 a=1，∠A=π/6，∠C=7π/12，得 c=sin(7π/12)/sin(π/6)。

计算 sin(7π/12)。因为 7π/12=π-5π/12，所以 sin(7π/12)=sin(5π/12)=sin(π/4+π/6)。展开得 sin(π/4+π/6)=sinπ/4 cosπ/6+cosπ/4 sinπ/6=(√2/2)(√3/2)+(√2/2)(1/2)=(√6+√2)/4。

又 sin(π/6)=1/2，因此 c=((√6+√2)/4)/(1/2)=(√6+√2)/2。

method.method_draft: 用坐标/向量几何求边 c=AB。把 A 放在原点，AB 放在 x 轴正方向，设 B=(c,0)。因为 ∠A=30°，点 C 在从 A 出发与 x 轴成 30° 的射线上。又 a=BC=1，且 ∠B=45°，所以从 B 到 C 的单位向量相对于 x 轴方向为 135°，即 BC 的分量为 (-√2/2, √2/2)，因此 C=(c-√2/2, √2/2)。由于 C 还在 30° 射线上，满足 y/x=tan30°=1/√3，于是 x=y/tan30°=(√2/2)·√3=√6/2。故 c=x+√2/2=(√6+√2)/2。
